title: Discovery call with Danielle on check-in wait times
body: Danielle walked through check-in pain at all three hospitals. Average wait at the main campus ER and outpatient registration is around 17 minutes, and front desk staff re-key paper forms into the EHR. Two hospitals have turnover above 30% at registration. She wants a pilot at one site this year. Next step: technical session with IT to scope EHR integration.

title: Discovery summary and stakeholders
body: Danielle is the sponsor and owns the budget request. CFO Raymond Teague will need to sign off above $150K, and Danielle expects pushback on cost. Priya Venkataraman runs clinical apps and controls the integration timeline. Competitor is already running a small pilot at one of their clinics.

title: Technical deep-dive: EHR integration
body: Walked Priya and her team through our HL7/FHIR interface and the demographics and insurance write-back. She is comfortable with the approach but wants a security review and a sandbox test before go-live. Estimated 8 to 10 weeks for integration. Open question on single sign-on for front-desk kiosks.

title: Proposal sent: $185K, three-hospital rollout
body: Sent proposal to Danielle with copy to Priya. Covers three hospitals, kiosk and tablet intake, EHR integration and year-one support at $185,000. Included a phased option starting with the main campus. Asked for feedback within a week.

title: Send security questionnaire and SOC 2 report to Priya
body: Priya asked for our SOC 2 report and the completed security questionnaire ahead of the sandbox test. Sent both.

title: CFO call: pricing objection and competitor pilot
body: Raymond said $185K is well above what he expected and pointed to the competitor's pilot, which he says is priced at roughly a third for one site. He questioned whether check-in savings are real or just soft time. Wants hard numbers on staffing and no-show impact before he will sign. Did not rule us out. Agreed to review an ROI summary.

title: Danielle asks for ROI summary for the CFO
body: Danielle emailed asking for a one-page ROI summary she can take to Raymond. She wants it to cover registration labor hours, reduced data-entry errors and claim denials tied to bad intake data, plus a comparison against a single-site pilot approach. Said the timing matters because contract review is next.

title: Send ROI summary to Danielle for CFO review
body: Build one-page ROI using their 17-minute wait and registration headcount. Include labor savings, denial reduction and a phased-rollout cost option to answer the competitor pilot comparison. Send to Danielle before her next meeting with Raymond.

title: Pricing and ROI review with Danielle and Raymond
body: Walk through the ROI summary and phased pricing option with the CFO. Goal is to resolve the pricing objection and get the contract signed before close.

title: Inbound demo request after webinar
body: Marguerite submitted a demo request right after our digital intake webinar. Form says 11 clinics, paper clipboards at most front desks, staff re-key everything into the EHR. Routed to me, qualified as worth a call.

title: Reply to demo request, propose intro call
body: Thanked her for attending the webinar, sent two time options for a 30 minute intro call and a short pre-call questionnaire on visit volume and current intake steps.

title: Intro call with Practice Ops Manager
body: Marguerite says check-in averages about 11 minutes and front desk staff spend roughly a third of the day on forms and data entry. Turnover at the desk is high. She wants to pilot at two of the eleven clinics first, one busy urgent care and one smaller family site. Needs to confirm EHR integration and get COO buy-in. Budget is not set; she thinks it sits with the COO.

title: Follow-up with pilot outline and EHR integration sheet
body: Sent recap, a one-page two-clinic pilot outline (8 week timeline) and our EHR integration sheet. Asked for clinic names and monthly visit counts so I can size pricing around the $42K range we discussed.

title: Build pilot ROI sketch for COO
body: Rough model: minutes saved per check-in times visits at the two pilot clinics, plus reduced re-keying hours. Keep it to one page.

title: Quick call to prep for COO meeting
body: Marguerite sent visit volumes. Urgent care site sees about 140 patients a day. She warned Thaddeus cares most about no added IT burden and wait-time scores. Suggested leading with integration and the pilot's low commitment. She will send him the one-pager beforehand.

title: Send agenda and ROI one-pager ahead of COO meeting
body: Email agenda, one-page ROI sketch and security overview to Marguerite and Thaddeus the day before the meeting.

title: Pilot discussion with COO
body: Intro meeting with Thaddeus Brennigan and Marguerite. Goals: confirm priorities, walk through pilot scope and ROI sketch, ask about budget process and approval path.

title: Ops champion sync
body: Lorelei wants check-in under 4 minutes, currently around 11. Casimir is worried about the payback period and a rival pilot at two sites.

title: CFO ROI walkthrough
body: Present a 3-year cost model with front-desk labor savings to Casimir and his finance team.

title: Kiosk specs sent
body: Sent kiosk hardware options and ADA requirements. Lorelei will review with facilities.

title: Draft kiosk pricing
body: Build a pricing tier for 14 outpatient lobbies and send to Lorelei.

title: Discovery intro
body: Tobias says patients fill out clipboards that staff retype, about 20 hours a week. Wants a demo for his two busiest clinics.

title: Product demo
body: Show tablet check-in and insurance card scan to Tobias and the front desk leads.

title: Lost to existing vendor
body: Tobias said they will stay with the forms module in their current EHR for now. Revisit next year.

title: Requirements call
body: Ingrid cites 9% claim denials from bad insurance data at intake. Dominic needs HL7 integration details.

title: Technical presentation
body: Walk Dominic's team through the integration architecture and security review.

title: Contract redlines
body: Legal returned minor redlines on data terms. Ingrid expects signature soon.

title: Follow up with legal
body: Confirm revised BAA language with their counsel.

title: Discovery call
body: Rosalind says registration lines hit 25 minutes on Monday mornings. Budget decisions happen next quarter.

title: Send case study
body: Email a case study from a similar-size hospital with wait time results.

title: Signed verbal approval
body: Rosalind confirmed approval for tablets at both satellite clinics. Go-live planned within the month.

body: Matilda liked the guardian consent flow but asked about Spanish language support.

title: Spanish workflow review
body: Show bilingual forms and consent capture to Matilda and two office managers.

title: Inbound inquiry
body: Matilda asked about text-based pre-visit forms to cut no-shows, currently near 14%.

title: Schedule intro call
body: Book a 30-minute scoping call with Matilda.

title: Executive review

title: Prepare references
body: Line up three hospital references for Beatrix's procurement packet.

title: Project shelved
body: Leopold said the ED project lost funding this year after an EHR upgrade took priority.

title: Needs discovery

title: Send grant-friendly quote
body: Prepare a quote with a phased rollout he can attach to a grant application.

title: Intro email reply
body: Evander replied that eligibility checks eat up front desk time. Open to a short call.

title: Intro call
body: Cover eligibility verification workflow and pricing basics.

title: Contract check-in
body: Cordelia is reviewing the order form with legal. She wants a 60-day implementation window.

title: Confirm implementation plan
body: Send a 60-day implementation timeline for her sign-off.

title: Closed and kickoff
body: Signed after a two-center pilot cut consent paper handling by half. Kickoff scheduled with Cordelia's team.

title: Privacy requirements
body: Septimus needs 42 CFR Part 2 handling and granular consent controls. Wants security documentation first.

title: Security review
body: Walk Septimus through our SOC 2 report and consent model.

title: Proposal sent
body: Sent a proposal for remote onboarding forms. Septimus is taking it to the clinical director.

title: Follow up on director feedback
body: Call Septimus to hear the clinical director's questions.

title: Initial scoping
body: Gideon says staffing is thin and patients drive hours, so pre-arrival forms matter. Broadband at some sites is unreliable.

title: Research connectivity options
body: Confirm offline sync capability and send technical notes to Gideon.

title: Went with in-house build
body: Gideon said their IT contractor will build basic forms internally. Left the door open for later.

title: Ops champion sync
body: Naomi says average check-in runs 14 minutes and wants it under 5. A competitor pilot is live at two campuses, so she asked for a side-by-side metrics comparison.

title: CFO ROI walkthrough
body: Present the cost model to Warren, who doubts the savings claims. Bring front-desk labor numbers from the ED pilot site.

title: Kiosk scope discussion
body: Naomi wants lobby kiosks at the four busiest clinics, contingent on the main platform decision. Budget not yet approved.

title: Send kiosk pricing sheet
body: Draft per-kiosk pricing with a three-site pilot option and send to Naomi.

title: Discovery call
body: Jocelyn's staff re-key paper forms for about 120 patients a day. She is open to a pilot at two clinics.

title: Workflow mapping session
body: Walk through front-desk process at the busiest urgent care with two receptionists.

title: Lost notice received
body: Jocelyn chose to stay with their billing vendor's built-in eligibility checks. Revisit next year if denial rates stay high.

title: Contract redlines
body: Hollis returned redlines on the SLA uptime clause, asking for 99.9%. Legal reviewing on our side.

title: Return revised MSA
body: Get security addendum and updated uptime terms back to Hollis.

title: CIO alignment call
body: Seraphina is on board if the EHR integration holds up in testing. She wants a reference from another ortho group.

body: IT team and our engineer review the HL7 interface and sandbox plan.

title: Needs review
body: Peregrine says parents fill out the same forms at every specialty visit. Wants one pre-visit portal in English and Spanish.

title: Share Spanish-language demo
body: Record a short demo of the bilingual form flow and send to Peregrine.

title: Signed order form
body: Peregrine returned the signed order. Kickoff set with registration leads for the consent workflow.

title: Product demo for leadership
body: Demo to Lucian and the nursing directors, focused on ED registration time.

body: Lucian said copay collection is handled by a separate vendor under contract for two more years.

body: Odalys wants to drop clipboards. Concerned about older patients and tablets, so asked about text-link options.

title: Send small-practice pricing
body: Email the per-provider pricing tier and a two-week trial offer.

body: Fitzgerald confirmed the CEO supports the rollout. He is pushing for a discount on all fourteen sites signed together.

title: Executive review
body: Meet Fitzgerald and the CEO to finalize scope and rollout phasing.

body: Tamsin signed after the grant funding came through. Go-live targeted for early next quarter.

title: Proposal follow-up
body: Barnaby said the surgeons like the pre-op questionnaire flow. Purchasing needs final pricing by end of month.

title: Confirm implementation timeline
body: Send Barnaby a six-week go-live plan with training dates.

title: Funding and needs
body: Rhiannon needs multilingual forms and a low-bandwidth option. Purchase depends on a grant decision next quarter.

title: Site visit planning call
body: Plan a visit to the two largest clinics to observe the front-desk flow.

title: Pilot comparison call with Annelise
body: Annelise says average check-in is 14 minutes and a rival is already piloting at two sites. She wants a side-by-side on kiosk and tablet intake before the CFO review.

title: CFO ROI review
body: Walk Mortimer through the payback model, which assumes 6 minutes saved per visit and 18 fewer front-desk FTE hours per clinic. Expect pushback on implementation cost.

title: Intro email after webinar
body: Corvin replied after our intake webinar. Staff spend about two hours a day re-keying forms into the EHR and he wants to see a demo.

title: Discovery call
body: Map current intake workflow across all five sites and confirm which EHR they use. Ask about budget timing for next fiscal year.

title: Requirements call
body: Ximena needs Spanish-language forms and insurance card scanning. Wait times in the ER lobby are the main complaint, with a target of under 8 minutes at check-in.

title: Prep tailored demo
body: Build a demo using Spanish-first intake flow and send the sandbox login to Ximena before the presentation.

title: Contract sent for signature
body: Sent the order form with the 3-year term. Dashiell is asking legal to review the data-retention clause and wants go-live before the spring surgery rush.

title: Follow up on legal redlines
body: Check in with Dashiell on contract redlines and offer a call with our security team if needed.

title: Loss call with Vesper
body: They chose to stay with their current EHR portal module because grant funding covers it this year. Vesper asked us to check back next budget cycle.
